<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>
  
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="heroFade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.12"/>
      <stop offset="48%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.35"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.88"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="heroGlow" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#2A0000" stop-opacity="0.88"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.12"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Hero backdrop -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="520" fill="#0A0A0A"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="520" fill="url(#heroGlow)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="520" fill="url(#heroFade)"/>

  <!-- Abstract promotional art built with geometric primitives -->
  <circle cx="72" cy="168" r="62" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
  <circle cx="305" cy="132" r="78" fill="#151515"/>
  <circle cx="250" cy="274" r="96" fill="#101010"/>
  <rect x="44" y="96" width="156" height="8" rx="4" fill="#EE1520" opacity="0.95"/>
  <rect x="62" y="116" width="112" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.16"/>
  <rect x="58" y="128" width="128" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.10"/>
  <rect x="170" y="62" width="140" height="6" rx="3" fill="#EE1520" opacity="0.7"/>
  <rect x="192" y="74" width="98" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.12"/>
  <rect x="28" y="248" width="334" height="2" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.06"/>
  <polygon points="252,118 284,168 220,168" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
  <circle cx="276" cy="108" r="14" fill="#EE1520" opacity="0.9"/>
  <polygon points="94,258 130,210 166,258" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
  <circle cx="112" cy="198" r="10" fill="#EE1520" opacity="0.75"/>
  <rect x="0" y="286" width="390" height="234" fill="#0E0E0E" opacity="0.92"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="28" font-family="Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <rect x="307" y="16" width="8" height="12" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="318" y="13" width="8" height="15" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="329" y="10" width="8" height="18" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="340" y="13" width="8" height="15" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="352" cy="22" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="359" y1="16" x2="365" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="358" y1="20" x2="366" y2="20" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="357" y1="24" x2="367" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="369" y="15" width="17" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="386" y="18" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Netflix logo -->
  <g transform="translate(25,52)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="62" height="18" rx="2" fill="#EE1520"/>
    <text x="11" y="13" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" letter-spacing="1">NETFLIX</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Help link -->
  <text x="346" y="68" text-anchor="end" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Help</text>

  <!-- Main headline -->
  <text x="26" y="378" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <tspan x="26" dy="0">Unlimited entertainment,</tspan>
    <tspan x="26" dy="36">one low price</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Subheadline -->
  <text x="26" y="458" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9">
    Stream and download as much as you want, no extra fees.
  </text>

  <!-- Onboarding dots -->
  <g transform="translate(146,487)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="4.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="16" cy="0" r="4.5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.35"/>
    <circle cx="32" cy="0" r="4.5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.35"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="0" r="4.5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.35"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Promo mini cards -->
  <g>
    <rect x="26" y="520" width="338" height="104" rx="10" fill="#131313"/>
    <rect x="28" y="522" width="334" height="100" rx="9" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
    <rect x="28" y="522" width="112" height="100" rx="9" fill="#2B0B0C"/>
    <circle cx="82" cy="566" r="28" fill="#00000066" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polygon points="76,556 76,576 92,566" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="156" y="549" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Download and go</text>
    <text x="156" y="572" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.85">
      Save your data, watch offline on a plane or commute.
    </text>
    <rect x="156" y="586" width="82" height="24" rx="12" fill="#EE1520"/>
    <text x="197" y="602" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Learn more</text>
  </g>

  <!-- SIGN IN button -->
  <g transform="translate(18,722)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="354" height="44" rx="2" fill="#EE1520"/>
    <text x="177" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">SIGN IN</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Secondary footer links -->
  <g>
    <text x="26" y="790" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Privacy</text>
    <text x="88" y="790" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Terms</text>
    <text x="144" y="790" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Cookies</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="806" width="390" height="38" fill="#000000"/>
  <g transform="translate(18,811)" opacity="0.45">
    <rect x="8" y="9" width="20" height="10" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="18,0 30,9 6,9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="18" y="32" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(105,811)" opacity="0.45">
    <circle cx="18" cy="14" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="25" y1="21" x2="31" y2="27" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="18" y="32" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Search</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(186,811)">
    <rect x="10" y="5" width="16" height="22" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="13" y="8" width="10" height="4" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="13" y="15" width="10" height="4" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="13" y="22" width="10" height="2" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="18" y="32" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Downloads</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(272,811)" opacity="0.45">
    <rect x="8" y="6" width="20" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="8" y1="6" x2="28" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="18" y="32" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">More</text>
  </g>
</svg>
